command:
set -euo pipefail
for f in "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-frank.desktop" "$HOME/.config/crush/crush.json" "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.sh" "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.py" "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush.py"; do echo '===== '

' ====='; if [ -f "$f" ]; then sed -n '1,320p' "$f"; else echo MISSING; fi; done
echo '===== COMMANDS ====='; command -v cool-retro-term || true; command -v gnome-terminal || true; command -v kitty || true; command -v alacritty || true; command -v xterm || true; command -v crush || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import shutil
for x in ['cool-retro-term','gnome-terminal','kitty','alacritty','xterm','crush','charm']:
 print(x, shutil.which(x))
PY
echo '===== PACKAGES ====='; dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'cool-retro|gnome-terminal|fonts.*terminus|fonts.*hack' || true
echo '===== ENV ====='; env | grep -E '^(XDG_SESSION_TYPE|DISPLAY|WAYLAND_DISPLAY|DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS|TERM|COLORTERM)=' | sort || true
